banner_text: Industry experts and sportsbook players giving Irish punters a clear, honest starting point.

intro.subtitle: Who We Are
intro.heading: Irish players deserve better information.
intro.body:
{{site_name}} started from one simple belief. For years, gambling review sites have let affiliate commissions shape their verdicts — praising the highest-paying brands regardless of quality, and ignoring good operators simply because they pay less. We set out to build something different: a resource where every rating is earned, never bought.

Our team brings together experienced gambling journalists, former sportsbook professionals and committed player advocates who, between them, have tested hundreds of platforms across Europe and beyond. Just as importantly, we're sportsbook players ourselves — so we know exactly what matters when you're the one placing the bet. Every sportsbook we cover is reviewed by a real person who signs up, deposits, plays, contacts support and requests a withdrawal.

That's the only honest way to understand what a platform is really like for the person on the other side of the screen. No shortcuts and no assumptions — just first-hand experience turned into practical advice.

experts.subtitle: Industry Experts & Players
experts.heading: Experts by trade. Punters by choice.
experts.body:
Our reviewers aren't observers looking in from the outside. We've built our careers inside the betting industry — in trading, compliance, product and marketing roles — and we understand how sportsbooks set their prices, structure their promotions and handle customers' money. We're also active sportsbook players in our own right: we follow the same Premier League fixtures, GAA championships and race meetings as our readers, and we claim the same welcome offers with our own money.

That dual perspective shapes everything we publish. Industry knowledge helps us read between the lines of the terms and conditions; first-hand experience as players tells us what it actually feels like when a withdrawal is delayed, an odds boost disappoints or an app crashes mid-match.

boxes.title: Industry insight
boxes.text: Years of experience inside the betting sector mean we know how offers are built, where the small print hides and which practices separate trustworthy operators from the rest.

boxes.title: Players ourselves
boxes.text: We bet on the same markets you do, with our own accounts. If an offer, an app or a payout process doesn't meet our standards as customers, it won't earn a recommendation.

boxes.title: Looking out for each other
boxes.text: Ireland's betting market is fiercely competitive, and operators compete hard for every new customer. We see our role as being in your corner — sharing what we learn, flagging unfair terms and slow payouts, and helping fellow punters bet with confidence.

principles.subtitle: What We Stand For
principles.heading: Our editorial principles
principles.intro: Four promises that shape **every review** and every ranking we publish.

boxes.title: Hands-on testing
boxes.text: Real accounts, real deposits and real withdrawals for every brand.

boxes.title: Independence
boxes.text: Commissions never decide a score or a review verdict.

boxes.title: Licensed only
boxes.text: We feature operators licensed for Ireland — and show the licence.

boxes.title: Player first
boxes.text: Safer gambling is part of every recommendation we make.
